what: A stack of photo cards in the same spot flips through on its own. While the front card steps back to the rear (40px down · .9 scale · .5 opacity), the second card moves forward (in place · 1 scale · 5° tilt released) and the third card shifts into the second’s spot (20px down · .95 scale · tilted 5° · .8). All move together over 1s power2.inOut, then rest 2.5s before the next card. Pauses when offscreen.

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards to stack (children) — two or more. The first card is on top
options.y: Distance dropped for each step back (px), default 20
options.tilt: Tilt of the second slot (deg), default 5 — 0 means straight
options.fade: Opacity for the second, third… slots (comma-separated), default .8,.5
options.dur: Duration (sec) of moving over, default 1 — 0 means instant
options.hold: Pause while showing one slide (s), default 2.5

from.where: index.html .sn-intro__stack (stack of three round photos beside the intro text) — original .js-intro_img timeline
